positionMethod.name: Position Method
positionMethod.description: The CSS positioning method used for the positioner element.

sideOffset.name: Side Offset
sideOffset.description: The offset distance between the popup and the trigger along the side axis.

alignOffset.name: Align Offset
alignOffset.description: The offset distance between the popup and the trigger along the alignment axis.

collisionPadding.name: Collision Padding
collisionPadding.description: The minimum distance to keep from viewport edges to avoid collision.

arrowPadding.name: Arrow Padding
arrowPadding.description: Padding between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

sticky.name: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether to keep the popup in view when the anchor scrolls out of bounds.

disableAnchorTracking.name: Disable Anchor Tracking
disableAnchorTracking.description: Whether to disable repositioning the popup when the anchor element moves.
